title: A finite torsion free module over a domain is a submodule of a finite free module
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma is an internal characterisation of finite torsion free modules over a domain, and the content is entirely in one direction (statement lines 4863-4867). The proof has to pass from the abstract module M to a concrete inclusion into a finite free module by choosing a basis of the finite dimensional K-vector space M tensor K, writing the finitely many generators of M in that basis with coefficients in K, clearing the finitely many denominators with one common element b, and then observing that torsion freeness is exactly what makes M embed into R e_1/b plus ... plus R e_r/b (proof lines 4870-4881). The two non-formal points are that a single denominator works for all generators at once and that the resulting map is injective precisely because M is torsion free; neither follows from finiteness alone.
